author: claude
desc: Find the exact reason m1n1's minilzlib XzDecode returns false on large -9e-compressed real initramfs. Established in 160: reproduces on the host harness (scripts/t6040-minilzlib-harness.sh); NOT a simple size limit (200 MiB zeros and 200 MiB real -6 both decode; 192 MiB real -9e decodes; 278 MiB real -9e fails), so it tracks compressed structure at -9e's 64 MiB dictionary, not uncompressed size. RULED OUT earlier: XZ block-header size metadata (flags 0x0000), dict-size property (checked only for >39 log2). CANDIDATES: (a) Lz2DecodeStream chunk loop returning false after N chunks; (b) the XzDecodeIndex VLI meta-check (MINLZ_META_CHECKS is defined) comparing UnpaddedBlockSize/UncompressedBlockSize where a VLI or accumulator is too narrow; (c) a uint32 wrap in a compressed-offset accumulator (input is ~67 MiB, within uint32, but intermediate products may not be). METHOD, all offline with the harness: instrument XzDecode/Lz2DecodeStream to print which check fails and at what chunk/offset, then bisect -9e real content to the exact crossover. If it is a genuine minilzlib bug, a minimal upstream-shaped fix in ~/Code/m1n1 would raise the real ceiling; if it is a spec limit, document it. Low priority — 128 MiB guard + harness already keep us safe. Evidence: evidence/2026-07-27-t6040-minilzlib-decode-limit-harness.md.
result: 2026-07-27 ROOT-CAUSED with a proven one-line fix. VLI_BYTES_MAX = sizeof(uint32_t)*8/7 = 4 (integer truncation of 32/7=4.57), should be ceil=5. The XZ index encodes UncompressedBlockSize as a VLI, so XzDecodeVli rejects any block >= 2^28 = 256 MiB at xzstream.c:117 (bitPos == 7*VLI_BYTES_MAX). Found by instrumenting the harness (return false -> logging expression): 278 MiB fails first at xzstream.c:117, 240 MiB has no failure. Boundary confirmed: 255 MiB (267386880) decodes, 256 MiB (268435456=2^28) fails. NOT content-dependent — corrects the earlier premature claim; all passing cases were simply <256 MiB. FIX patches/m1n1-minilzlib-vli-bytes-max.patch (VLI_BYTES_MAX = ((sizeof(vli_type)*8+6)/7) = 5) applies cleanly to m1n1 and makes the harness decode the 278 MiB image with normal images unchanged; not yet applied to the m1n1 tree (separate repo, awaits maintainer). Evidence: evidence/2026-07-27-t6040-minilzlib-vli-256mib-rootcause.md.
